headline: Video: Gold Jewelry Entrepreneurs Support Gold Export Duty, Why?
summary: Indonesian jewelry makers support a gold export duty under the Prabowo era, arguing that domestic firms can easily source gold raw materials.
why: Export duties on gold affect domestic refiners and jewelers, and they change how much raw gold stays in Indonesia for local processing.
